theorem QOU.Hecke.TwistedChannelSplitting.six_strand_spin_twist_split_eq_zero_iff {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (tr : A →ₗ[R] R) (θ p p' : A) (q : R) (hq : q ≠ 0) (h : θ * p = BraidKnot.Keystone.theta q [4, 2] • p) (h' : θ * p' = BraidKnot.Keystone.theta q [3, 3] • p') (hp : tr p ≠ 0) (hp' : tr p' ≠ 0) :
tr (θ * p) * tr p' - tr (θ * p') * tr p = 0 ↔ q ^ 2 = 1

theorem QOU.Hecke.TwistedChannelSplitting.six_strand_spin_twist_split {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (tr : A →ₗ[R] R) (θ p p' : A) (q : R) (h : θ * p = BraidKnot.Keystone.theta q [4, 2] • p) (h' : θ * p' = BraidKnot.Keystone.theta q [3, 3] • p') :
tr (θ * p) * tr p' - tr (θ * p') * tr p = (q ^ 5 - q ^ 3) * (tr p * tr p')

theorem QOU.Hecke.TwistedChannelSplitting.theta_four_two {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (hq : q ≠ 0) :
BraidKnot.Keystone.theta q [4, 2] = q ^ 2 * BraidKnot.Keystone.theta q [3, 3]

theorem QOU.Hecke.TwistedChannelSplitting.theta_pair_pow_four_ratio {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (hq : q ≠ 0) (a b a' b' : ℕ) (hn : a + b = a' + b') :
BraidKnot.Keystone.theta q [a, b] ^ 4 = BraidKnot.Keystone.theta q [a', b'] ^ 4 * q ^ ((↑a - ↑b) * (↑a - ↑b + 2) - (↑a' - ↑b') * (↑a' - ↑b' + 2))

theorem QOU.Hecke.TwistedChannelSplitting.contentSum_three_three :
MathlibExt.QPartitionCombinatorics.contentSum [3, 3] = 3

theorem QOU.Hecke.TwistedChannelSplitting.contentSum_four_two :
MathlibExt.QPartitionCombinatorics.contentSum [4, 2] = 5

theorem QOU.Hecke.TwistedChannelSplitting.four_mul_contentSum_pair (a b : ℕ) :
4 * MathlibExt.QPartitionCombinatorics.contentSum [a, b] = (↑a - ↑b) * (↑a - ↑b + 2) + (↑a + ↑b) * (↑a + ↑b - 4)

theorem QOU.Hecke.TwistedChannelSplitting.two_mul_contentSum_pair (a b : ℕ) :
2 * MathlibExt.QPartitionCombinatorics.contentSum [a, b] = ↑a * (↑a - 1) + ↑b * (↑b - 3)

theorem QOU.Hecke.TwistedChannelSplitting.two_mul_sum_range_sub (m i : ℕ) :
2 * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (↑j - ↑i) = ↑m * (↑m - 1) - 2 * ↑i * ↑m

theorem QOU.Hecke.TwistedChannelSplitting.spin_only_twist_split_eq_zero_iff {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] [IsDomain R] (tr : A →ₗ[R] R) (θ p p' : A) (s s' : R) (h : θ * p = s • p) (h' : θ * p' = s' • p') (hp : tr p ≠ 0) (hp' : tr p' ≠ 0) :
tr (θ * p) * tr p' - tr (θ * p') * tr p = 0 ↔ s = s'

theorem QOU.Hecke.TwistedChannelSplitting.spin_only_twist_split {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (tr : A →ₗ[R] R) (θ p p' : A) (s s' : R) (h : θ * p = s • p) (h' : θ * p' = s' • p') :
tr (θ * p) * tr p' - tr (θ * p') * tr p = (s - s') * (tr p * tr p')

theorem QOU.Hecke.TwistedChannelSplitting.symmetric_twist_no_split {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (tr : A →ₗ[R] R) (θ p p' : A) (s s' : R) (h : θ * p = s • p) (h' : θ * p' = s' • p') :
tr (θ * p) * tr (θ * p') - tr (θ * p') * tr (θ * p) = 0

theorem QOU.Hecke.TwistedChannelSplitting.twisted_split {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (tr : A →ₗ[R] R) (θS θI p p' : A) (s s' i i' : R) (hS : θS * p = s • p) (hS' : θS * p' = s' • p') (hI : θI * p = i • p) (hI' : θI * p' = i' • p') :
tr (θS * p) * tr (θI * p') - tr (θS * p') * tr (θI * p) = (s * i' - s' * i) * (tr p * tr p')
